question: Does one fixed pretrained representation separate ten resolved excluded development checks using only ten resolved SAC references, while preserving unknowns and revealing exposed regression failures?

encoder.embedding: final layer-normalized CLS token exposed as pooler_output

input.data_source: Hash-verified existing raw PNGs and saved selected/candidate points, never accepted center labels or new source video decoding.

execution.feature_normalization: Save raw float32 CLS, convert to float64, reject nonfinite or zero norm, then L2-normalize in float64
execution.similarity: cosine dot products of the float64-normalized vectors
execution.implementation_status: not_implemented_or_run; approval permits focused implementation validation and one fixed screen

decision.reference_bank: All ten resolved SAC examples; four ball and six other_object. No unresolved item or check enters the bank.
decision.class_rule: Compare maximum cosine similarity to ball references with maximum similarity to other-object references; larger maximum supplies nearest-reference preference; exact ties abstain.
decision.unknowns: All six accepted unresolved records stay unscored; report similarities/preferences without changing their labels.
decision.exposed_regression: All prior34 saved selected points:20 mean provenance,14 contributor provenance. Report exact neighbors and disagreements with prior AI judgments separately, never pool them with ten accepted checks or treat AI judgments as newly accepted ground truth.
decision.qualitative_challenges: Flag known SAC1419-1421 head episode if ball-preferred/tied, and valid near-head DET balls if other-preferred/tied. Any adverse or unresolved challenge prevents advancing to a policy without review.
decision.failure: Complete and retain the report; reject only this fixed encoder/crop/reference setup. No alternate encoder, crop, threshold, bank resampling or tuning under this proposal.
decision.success: Only supports a later bounded conservative policy/data proposal with missing head/clothing/NFHS/contributor coverage addressed; no automatic verifier or trajectory promotion.

deliverables: Immutable source/crop/feature bindings and all60 feature rows
All neighbor identities and similarities for50 queries, with source/episode roles
Ten-check outcome table, six unknown audits and34 separate exposed regressions
Compact crop/neighbor review including all queried cases and rationale for any next step
constraints: No original observation, candidate coordinate, label or checkpoint changes
Do not convert current or historical unknowns into negative labels
Existing regression/continuous results and completed reviews remain intact
No new trajectory video is implied because this screen changes no trajectory
approval_reason: A new representation and scientific experiment requires Ryan approval under docs/context/working_agreement.md; current acceptance covers label publication and evidence adequacy assessment.
